Genshin Impact.status: All currently planned Bento Genshin regions through Nod-Krai are represented; game content is isolated behind the Games browser.

photoStrategy: Real online food photography from Wikimedia Commons; game/anime artwork is not used as recipe photography.
navigation: Cuisines, Meals, Desserts, Drinks, icon-only Games and Anime discovery.
gameIsolation: Game/anime recipes are excluded from Cuisines, Meals, Desserts, Drinks, their counts, and automatic Kitchen Magic/Cook With discovery. They remain usable when deliberately opened from Games.
cacheFix: Navigation stays network-first; explicitly versioned app/data/style assets are cache-first after successful install to avoid repeat network waits without mixed-version builds.
performance: Recipe cards remain batch-rendered (30 at a time); cuisine selection filters the standard pool before search/sort work; photos stay lazy/on-demand; game content remains isolated from normal cuisine/meal/dessert/drink discovery; core versioned assets remain cache-first after successful install.
cuisineNavigation: Single compact cuisine dropdown with All cuisines plus each installed cuisine; designed to scale to the full planned cuisine library without card-grid crowding.
